description: This file defines test filters for the Starboard Evergreen X64 platform, including filtering specific tests and conditionally removing certain tests based on the presence of a content decryption module.

classes.name: EvergreenX64TestFilters
classes.description: A class that extends shared test filters to include specific test filtering logic for the Evergreen X64 platform.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of test filters, extending base filters with platform-specific filters and conditionally removing certain tests based on the presence of a content decryption module.
